name: Elena Quispe
bio:
Elena Quispe's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Growing up in Lima, she was always tinkering with engines, initially fixing up her family's aging car. This practical experience led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, where she excelled in materials science and advanced manufacturing techniques. After graduating, she spent several years working in the aerospace industry, honing her skills in precision fabrication and quality control. However, the allure of motorsport proved too strong to resist, and she made the leap to Inter Europol Competition, drawn by the team's ambitious spirit and commitment to innovation.

As a fabricator, Elena is known for her meticulous attention to detail and her ability to solve complex technical challenges. She thrives on the pressure of tight deadlines and enjoys collaborating with engineers to optimize vehicle performance. Her lone wolf tendencies mean she prefers working independently, focusing intensely on the task at hand. Elena's aerospace background gives her a unique perspective on materials and construction, enabling her to identify areas for improvement that others might miss. Her dedication to perfection and her unwavering commitment to quality make her a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, braided, often tucked under a cap
physical.description: Elena is of average height with a strong build, reflecting years spent working with heavy machinery.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical drawings and notes.
Has a habit of tapping her wrench against metal surfaces when deep in thought.
Dislikes working with others on fabrication, preferring to work alone and meticulously.
